title: Compressible Navier--Stokes equations with a potential force: global well-posedness and optimal time-decay rates for arbitrarily large $L^2$ initial data
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for the three-dimensional barotropic compressible Navier--Stokes equations with a time-independent potential force near a spatially nonconstant stationary state. The potential is controlled in unweighted homogeneous Besov spaces; in particular, no polynomial spatial-weight condition involving $(1+|x|)^j\nabla^jφ$ is imposed.
